recent_posts: The cedi trades at 11.0 per dollar, its strongest level in 145 days. It has gained 4.8% over the past 90 days and now ranks as the best-performing currency of 132 tracked this month. #Ghana $GHS

The ruble is trading at 84.9 per dollar, having weakened 6.9% over the month and 2.7% over the week. This is the second-fastest weakening rate among 132 currencies this month, and the ruble is only 2.6% from its yearly low. #Russia $RUB

The Algerian dinar holds at 133.0 to the dollar, with no significant move (less than 0.25%) for 17 days. But the five independent sources making up the fixing diverged by 0.62%, double the usual 0.26%. #Algeria $DZD
The lilangeni sits at 16.2 per dollar, little changed this week but 8.8% stronger than a year ago, when it traded near 17.6. It is now 8.8% above its weakest point of the past year. #Eswatini $SZL
